--- title: "Grad Student Spotlight" --- ::: {.cell} ::: ### Grad Student Spotlight - Episode 1: Carl Vigren *July 27, 2023*
Watch on YouTube
Listen on Spotify
Carl Vigren is a PhD student at the Swedish University of Agriculture Sciences in the Department of Forest Resource Management. He is an expert in forest modeling and creator of the forester repository on GitHub (https://github.com/Silviculturalist/forester), a collection of forestry functions and models. --- ### Grad Student Spotlight - Episode 2: Suveksha Jha *September 29, 2023*
Watch on YouTube
Listen on Spotify
Suveksha Jha is a masters student at the University of Georgia in the Warnell School of Forestry and Natural Resources. Her masters work is centered on the integration of LiDAR data and Growth and Yield models. Be sure to check out her presentation at the upcoming SOMENS and NEMO meeting in Knoxville, TN. --- ### Grad Student Spotlight - Episode 3: Olakunle Joshua *January 30, 2025*
Watch on YouTube
Listen on Spotify
Joshua is a PhD student in the SUNY College of Environmental Science and Forestry and founder of The Achiever's Gathering, Nigeria (TAGNG). --- All episodes are also available on our [YouTube channel](https://www.youtube.com/@TheForestersForecast-wb3jl) and [Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/show/4fzgYVHRlYACdPJiM93L3C).
